How to Survive the Horror Novel I Wrote
Yazdığım Korku Romanında Hayatta Kalma Rehberi

description:
Writing horror was her passion. Now, it’s her nightmare.

Bestselling author Ha Ji-an inherits a **cursed keyboard** that turns whatever she types into **reality**. But when she accidentally summons Joo Woo-geum—the **ruthless serial killer** from her own book—he doesn't cut her down. He confesses his love.
Ji-an knows the terrifying truth: Woo-geum is a monster who kills the ones he loves. Desperate to change the story, she tries to rewrite his fate, but an unknown force keeps erasing her words.

 *How do you escape a killer when you’re the one who gave him life?*
